class.name: ObjCClass
class.description: Represents a Objective-C class. It is returned from [method ObjCClassWrapper.wrap] or other [ObjCClass] method. [b]Note:[/b] This class only works on macOS. On any other platform, this class does nothing.

method.name: create_instance
method.description: Creates new instance of this class object.

method.name: get_objc_method_list
method.description: Returns the object's Objective-C methods and their signatures as an [Array] of dictionaries, in the same format as [method Object.get_method_list]. [b]Note:[/b] Due to GDScript limitations [code]:[/code] characters in the method name are replaced with [code]_[/code].

method.name: get_objc_parent_class
method.description: Returns a [ObjCClass] representing the Objective-C parent class of this class.
